title: Pool report drifted 129E to 117E between reads; re-derived live before queueing
body: The committed logs/basedpyright_report.json summary read 129E/39W during close-out but the worktree copy read 117E/39W at lane start (recorded_at 01:16:53Z, after slice E/F landed). Per lesson 4583 the queue was built from the live worktree report plus a live per-file basedpyright re-run (8E/8W confirmed), never from the stale number.

title: Concurrent actor landed slice E between verify and commit; re-derived HEAD before landing F
body: Slice E's 8 staged files were verified 0E/0W, then HEAD advanced 5ea94318 to 6307da2f as a concurrent actor landed the identical sweep. Commit attempt correctly reported nothing to commit. Lesson: on this tree, git add and git commit must fire in one burst and HEAD must be re-checked after every gate run.

title: Preflight IndexDrift warning during shared-index window; re-staged and landed clean
body: The commit hook reported IndexDrift (file on disk changed mid-hook, concurrent writer in the ~40s hook window) with ALLOW_PREFLIGHT=1 override; wiring_audit still landed byte-identical to the verified fix inside harvest commit ee7c2830. Treat any IndexDrift as a re-verify trigger, not background noise.

title: Removed 4-hour-stale index.lock with zero live git processes, then landed immediately
body: Commit failed with index.lock dated Oct 21 21:20 while wall clock was Oct 22 01:31 UTC and ps showed no git processes; two concurrent slice commits had landed through other means in between. Per git's own crashed-process guidance the orphaned lock was removed and add+commit fired in the same burst, with this entry recording the evidence for the other lane.

title: Triaged arxiv/orkg register_pattern double-encoding out of slice H into a design follow-up
body: Both indexers pass json.dumps output where LocalMemoryStore.register_pattern expects list[float] and dict and dumps again, so stored embedding and metadata columns are double-encoded and unreadable by vector readers. Fixing the call to pass raw objects leaves a list[str]-vs-list[float] mismatch no honest local edit can clear, because keywords cannot become floats without inventing embedding semantics. Left in pool, replaced in slice H by auto_install and config, follow-up goal recorded.

title: Slice I: None-tolerant widening beats test-weakening; dead probe call kept dead but honest
body: weakness_testing None-passing tests encode the hardened-class contract, so the fix widened record_event and normalize_task to str|None instead of touching the tests. install_manager called probe() with kwargs the real signature never accepted, so every call raised TypeError into the except; replaced with a documented no-op probe() that returns None the same way. TF warnings marked with the subsystem-precedent ignore since guarded try/except already fails open and TF is env-optional.

title: Import smoke regenerated tracked AOA diagrams; restored via checkout
body: Importing AOA.build and AOA.build_disclosure for smoke executes module-level diagram writers that overwrote tracked AOA_STRUCTURE.html and AOA_DISCLOSURE.html in the worktree. Noticed in git status, restored both from HEAD. Lesson: check status after any import-smoke of modules with top-level side effects, and prefer importing the narrow submodule over the script module.

title: Reverted a correct 29-error fix on unverified evidence; out-of-project typecheck lied
body: Worktree cli.py (BatchResult isinstance narrowing) looked like чуж uncommitted churn, and a basedpyright run on a HEAD copy at /tmp reported 0E so I reverted it. /tmp has no project import context, so the run was meaningless: in-place HEAD cli.py holds 29E and the reverted edit was the exact correct fix. Re-derived it from the live diagnostics and re-applied. Rules: never revert worktree edits that are not yours without an in-place verify first, and never trust a typecheck run on a file copied outside the project tree.

title: Slice K: 8 files 36E to 0E; Path-in-bytes compare meant a dead scan
body: cli.py 29E via InferenceResult|BatchResult isinstance narrowing (re-derivation of f22-08); DIAGNOSTIC_WORM compared Path in bytes so every file raised TypeError into the except and scan_bad_syspath never matched anything — encoding the pattern fixed the type error and activated the scan (returns list, 0 hits live); LOCAL_DEV bootstrap now find_spec plus import_module per the file's own OPEN_INTERPRETER precedent since no static from-import can resolve an absent module; MemoryBus headers annotated dict[str,str] with a single _pams_api_key call; smoke ran DEPENDZ.run and the worm scan, worktree held exactly the 8 files.

title: Slice L: smoke falsified a stub-gap theory into a real crash; fromisoformat is the fix
body: SMARTDISK fromisoparse looked like a missing stub (absent even in a scratch repro), but the smoke run raised AttributeError at runtime: fromisoparse never existed in stdlib (dateutil's isoparse is the similar name), so analyze_trends crashed on any non-empty history and the empty-history early return hid it. fromisoformat is the exact inverse of the isoformat timestamps the file writes. Same smoke proved the IsolationForest contamination float fits for real, the freethreading pool binding works, and the inference-subscriber guard passes a live worm. Suppressions used only where the signature itself lies: sklearn's contamination str annotation and the try/except FreeThreadPool dual binding, both with reason comments and repo precedent.

title: Slice M: 8 files 8E to 0E; watchdog bytes path is real, pydantic fallback needed a body
body: watchdog types src_path as bytes|str and the runtime confirms bytes occur, so the isinstance-decode guard replaces a crash on undecodable paths; the pydantic-absent fallback ValidationError gained a real errors method plus the same try/except-dual-binding ignore the freethreading fallback uses, after proving the checker's type() call cannot carry members; broker ObjectProxy ignore extended to reportArgumentType with the wrapt-no-stubs reason and proven by driving gate_asserted to advance_to_code_edit and calling a double-wrapped tool for 42; exmachina pairs annotated to the discover signature's own Dict[str, Sequence[float]] and proven with a live discover call.

title: Slice N 8 files reach 0 errors plus live execution smoke
body: All 8 slice N files (hyper_optimizer, parallel, inference_pool, logging_config, memory_diagnostic, meta_evolution, secrets_manager, threading_utils) verify at 0 errors under 3.15t basedpyright after annotation fixes; live smoke of HyperOptimizer._execute_single_with_semaphore with a stub provider returns success with content, tokens, and confidence, proving the fixed path executes and not only typechecks.

title: Smoke stubs must mirror the real provider surface or the smoke lies
body: First hyper_optimizer smoke failed on FakeProv missing has_valid_key and second on _execute_batch missing batch_label; both were stub-shape gaps, not file bugs. Read the real signature (inspect.signature) before writing the stub so a red smoke means the file is broken, never the harness.

title: Slice O kills 13 errors: house-pattern fallback, dict metadata, str(ML_PATH)
body: Seven **kw register_worm fallbacks now carry the real signature copied from CORE/worm_registry.py and the CAIN_WORM house pattern, so both import branches share one shape. arxiv/orkg pass the metadata dict straight to register_pattern, which serializes internally -- the old pre-encoded string was stored double-encoded. Four sys.path.insert call sites now insert str(ML_PATH), which also repairs the dedupe guard that could never match a Path against str entries.

title: Copy the fallback signature from the producer source, not from memory
body: The **kw fallback looked compatible but was not assignable to the real decorator type. CAIN_WORM and ten other files already carried the correct explicit fallback; transcribing that exact shape into the seven broken files fixed all of them with zero invention. When a fallback exists in N files, the correct text is already in the tree.

title: Slice P kills 9 errors: package import, Optional defaults, producer widening
body: vocab_migration now imports EVENT_VOCAB from the CORE package where it is actually defined instead of audit_trail where it never existed. Three implicit-None defaults became explicit Optional. safe_copytree ignore widened to Iterable[str] to match shutil.copytree, which receives the value untouched -- the annotation contradicted its own docstring. launcher fallback carries a line-scoped pyright ignore because bare config only resolves with ml_platforms on the runtime sys.path, verified live.

title: pyright ignore comments are line-scoped, not block-scoped
body: A standalone pyright ignore comment three lines above the flagged import did nothing; moving it to the end of the exact reported line cleared the finding. Always place the ignore on the diagnostic line itself and re-run to confirm.

title: Graph rebuilt via update --force: 44701 nodes, 83647 edges, 2550 communities, exit 0
body: Direct CLI GRAPHIFY_FORCE=1 graphify update --force (full refresh script skipped: cosmos/Desktop/CDP steps out of turf). Log /tmp/graphify_update_20261022.log: 294/294 AST, pruned 77 nodes from 1 newly-ignored file (legit shrink the guard refused), Rebuilt 44701/83647/2550, graph.json mtime 09:21 newer than HEAD dac211ba 08:38. graphify-out gitignored (.gitignore:106): no slice commit for graph itself. Traversal lesson: MCP seeds miss function nodes, file-node path routes via json import; live git grep at HEAD stays the companion proof, graph gives file structure (orchestrator degree 37, intake degree 16).

title: tree_sitter_powershell sdist ships no scanner.c; fetched tag-matched file, MSVC-built, extractor verified Log() L12
body: pip build failed LNK2001 (5 unresolved externals): sdist 0.26.4 has parser.c (16 external_scanner refs) but no src/scanner.c, and setup.py only appends scanner `if path.exists` — upstream packaging gap. Fix: fetched src/scanner.c from airbus-cert/tree-sitter-powershell tag v0.26.4 (verified Microsoft header, 10 symbol refs), pip install . --no-build-isolation with local MSVC (cl 14.51, Py_GIL_DISABLED=1, cp315t target) — built+installed clean. Proof through graphify extractor: extract_powershell(archive_graphs_to_d.ps1) -> file node + Log() L12 + 1 edge, error None (was: tree_sitter_powershell not installed, 0 nodes). Flat scripts correctly yield file-node-only (0 functions in refresh/verify scripts). GIL note: core 0.26.0 is latest and still lacks the free-thread declaration (reproduced on py315t) — no pip fix exists; warning is truthful, do not silence.

title: Two silent background deaths falsified: backslash path (exit 127) and Beam add -f (ignored+untracked bake file)
body: Foreground repro beat background-log forensics. (1) Wrapper passed backslash Windows path to bash -> path mangled to C:Azazael... -> exit 127 with near-empty logs; fix: as_posix() + OSError guard (commit 983f74d3, scanner gate clean). (2) Beam row written but uncommitted: beam bake file is gitignored+untracked (state/* rule; check-ignore Y, ls-files n) while landed lane files bypass via tracking — plain `git add` fails on it, needs `git add -f`. Amended #1666 with the -f note. Lesson: `git ls-files --error-unmatch` + `git check-ignore -q` decides tracked/ignored in one pass; never infer landing state from line counts.

title: Full update died mid-pipeline after AST with no error; artifacts intact, cause undetermined
body: Second update run (post-ps1-fix verification) completed 295/295 AST then vanished: no Rebuilt line, no EXIT, no process, graph.json untouched (mtime still 09:21, valid 44701-node build). No artifact damage — atomic writes + #479 guard held. Candidates: harness reaping, OOM in clustering, machine throttle — none proven. Recorded as unknown, not reconstructed. Retry strategy for next run: foreground SYNC with pipefail so the failure, if any, is observed not inferred; the per-file extractor proof (Log() L12) already covers the ps1 fix independently of a full rebuild.
